idea:
Restore real-time streaming of stdout to `agent-output-*.log` log files during non-tmux backend execution. Currently, output is buffered in memory and written only after the child process exits, which breaks `ralph tail` and live log monitoring for long-running commands.

## Summary

In `execute_streaming` (`src/backend/mod.rs`), stdout chunks must be written to `log_writer` incrementally as they arrive in the read loop, not deferred until after `child.wait()`.

## Requirements

- Write each stdout chunk to `log_writer` inside the read loop as it arrives
- Continue updating `last_activity` on each read (heartbeat/idle-timeout must remain functional)
- Continue accumulating bytes into `captured_stdout` for post-exit normalization
- Remove or guard the post-exit `log_writer.write_bytes(&captured_stdout)` call to prevent duplicate content in log files

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `agent-output-*.log` files grow in real time during non-tmux backend execution
- [ ] `ralph tail` and `tail -f` show live progress during execution
- [ ] Heartbeat idle-timeout behavior is unaffected
- [ ] Post-exit output normalization still works correctly
- [ ] No duplicate content appears in log files
- [ ] Existing tests pass
